title: Clear Kayaking Glow Tour in Tampa Riverwalk
includes: Safety equipment including lifejackets and whistles
Tandem kayaks, lights, paddles, seats, and dry bags.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a magical nighttime adventure on the Hillsborough River and experience Tampa's iconic landmarks illuminated by our glowing clear kayaks. Our knowledgeable guides will share fascinating stories about Tampa's rich history and vibrant culture as we paddle past Amature Works, the Straz Center, and the University of Tampa. You may see otters, dolphins, manatees and birds along the river. Book your tour today and create unforgettable memories under the stars!

for everyone's safety, our tandem clear kayaks have a weight limit of 250 lbs per person and 425 lbs per kayak.
